source.name: Design-system color scales (official npm packages)
source.license: Color values read from each design system's published npm package (license per item, all permissive). Values are facts; summary is the docs page's own meta description.
source.note: metrics.downloads = npm downloads last month of the package (for big UI kits this counts the whole kit, not just colors). Tailwind v4 values are OKLCH (kept in value) with an sRGB hex approximation.

items.name: Ant Design colors
items.summary: Ant Design interprets the color system into two levels: a system-level color system and a product-level color system.
items.summaryKo: Ant Design의 기본 색 단계표(1~10). 기업용 관리 화면에서 많이 쓴다.

items.name: Bootstrap 5 colors
items.summary: Bootstrap is supported by an extensive color system that themes our styles and components. This enables more comprehensive customization and extension for any project.
items.summaryKo: Bootstrap 5의 기본 색과 회색 단계. 나머지 단계는 Sass 함수로 섞어 만든다.

items.name: IBM Carbon colors
items.summary: IBM Carbon color guidance helps teams create consistent, engaging, and accessible user interfaces across digital products and experiences.
items.summaryKo: IBM Carbon 디자인 시스템의 색 단계표(10~100).

items.name: Chakra UI colors
items.summary: The list of available color tokens
items.summaryKo: Chakra UI v3의 기본 색 단계표(50~950).

items.name: Microsoft Fluent 2 colors
items.summary: Color is a powerful tool for expressing style, emotion, and meaning. Learn about Fluent
items.summaryKo: 마이크로소프트 Fluent 2의 회색 단계와 공용 색(shade·tint).

items.name: Mantine colors
items.summary: React components and hooks library with native dark theme support and focus on usability, accessibility and developer experience
items.summaryKo: Mantine의 기본 색 단계표(0~9). Open Color를 바탕으로 한다.

items.name: Material Design color palette (2014)
items.summary: Build beautiful, usable products faster. Material Design is an adaptable system—backed by open-source code—that helps teams build high quality digital experiences.
items.summaryKo: 구글 머티리얼 디자인 초판의 색 단계표(50~900, A100~A700).

items.name: Open Color
items.summaryKo: 화면 디자인용으로 고른 13가지 색 × 10단계. 한국 개발자(heeyeun)가 만들었다.

items.name: Open Props colors
items.summary: Open source CSS custom properties to help accelerate adaptive and consistent design. Available from a CDN or NPM, as CSS or Javascript.
items.summaryKo: CSS 변수로 바로 쓰는 색 단계표(Open Color 바탕, 0~12).

items.name: Primer color scales (GitHub)
items.summary: An overview of all available color CSS variables
items.summaryKo: GitHub 화면에 쓰는 Primer 디자인 시스템의 기본 색 단계표.

items.name: Radix Colors
items.summary: An open-source color system for designing beautiful, accessible websites and apps.
items.summaryKo: 접근성을 맞춰 설계한 12단계 색 체계. 밝은·어두운 모드 짝이 함께 있다.

items.name: Adobe Spectrum color palette
items.summary: Spectrum’s color system is used for all colored components, text, and icons, for both semantic and non-semantic usage. We also use colors in our data ...
items.summaryKo: Adobe Spectrum 디자인 시스템의 색 단계표. 밝은·어두운 모드 값이 따로 있다.

items.name: Tailwind CSS colors
items.summary: Using and customizing the color palette in Tailwind CSS projects.
items.summaryKo: Tailwind CSS에 들어 있는 기본 색 단계표(50~950). 클래스 이름으로 바로 쓴다.
